name: Kalrav AI Agent
author: irisideatechsolutions

sections.description: Kalrav AI Agent is a powerful, customizable AI kalravai plugin designed to enhance user engagement and support on your WordPress website. It adds a floating, interactive chat widget to every page, helping visitors get quick answers, discover content, and connect with your services – all powered by real-time AI conversations.
